windows.60: Visitors have noted issues with the food offerings, describing the menu as limited and some items as bland or poorly prepared. Several reviews mention dissatisfaction with the quality and variety of food, including complaints about the absence of common sides and the presentation of certain dishes. There are also comments about the cost not matching the experience, with some feeling the visit was overpriced. Service and wait times were mentioned less frequently but still appeared in a few reviews. Overall, the library’s atmosphere received some positive remarks, but food-related concerns were the most common area needing attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that kitchen delays forced the café to offer only grab-and-go options for extended periods. Many found the food overpriced and of low quality, mentioning small portions and unappealing preparation. The range of menu choices was also criticized as too narrow. These concerns about food quality, value, and service have been the most frequent topics in critical feedback.
